claim: A venue's marquee is animated shade, not geometry: threshold sectors at the mouth carry an xsector shade wave. Every E1M4 attraction mouth has it (the ring's mouth 9 animated sectors, others 1-3) and E3M1's saloon and its neighbour carry one each. Signs cluster within 2,048 of the door on the public side (39 face sprites round 7 doorways in E3M1's complex).
evidence: tools/mine_venues.py over E1M4, E3M1 and DWE3M1: 9 animated mouth sectors on E1M4's ring, 1-3 on its other attractions, 1 each on E3M1's saloon and neighbour (venue-mining.json)
use: Give each venue door one or more flickering threshold sectors and its signs on the street side; it costs no walls.
